incidents.symptom: The first label-free runner invocation stopped before backend construction because the immutable safe-bank manifest has no path field.
incidents.diagnosis: The manifest intentionally preserves candidate_id and file_sha256; the runner incorrectly assumed a path field.
incidents.repair: Reconstruct the historical candidate path only as CANDIDATE_DIRECTIONS/<candidate_id>.npy and continue to verify the persisted file SHA-256.
